info.label: downloaded historical
info.missing_data_policy: Prices stored as received; no back-filling with later data. At estimation time gaps are forward-filled from the last past observation for at most 5 trading days. Assets without a price within 5 trading days of the training start, or with < 95 % training coverage, are dropped with an explicit issue. Held-out metrics use buy-and-hold from the last close before the segment.
info.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance 1.7.0 — daily adjusted close, NSE (.NS) tickers
info.survivorship_note: Universe is the NIFTY 50 membership as of 2026-10-08, applied to earlier periods. Stocks that left the index are absent and recent entrants are included before they joined, so historical (including held-out) performance is subject to survivorship bias.
info.universe_source: NSE Indices official NIFTY 50 constituent list (ind_nifty50list.csv)
